name: Mayu
source:
Call the protagonist Oni-chan
Not bad at studying, but don't like it
Hobby: behaving spoiled to her Oni-chan
Like cake
Dislike Shiitake (mushroom)
Dislike being treated as a child
Dream for the future: living with her Oni-chan
